title: Pills (deprecated)
description: Deprecated in 1.0: use SegmentedControl for 2–5 filter values shown in full (with counts and a sliding raised-2 pill) or PillTabs for 5+ page sections with icons. Kept exported so existing screens continue to compile until migrated.
when: Legacy screens not yet migrated to SegmentedControl or PillTabs.

instead.need: 2–5 filter values shown in full, with counts
5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons
2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page

a11y: Each option is a button with aria-pressed; Tab moves between options. SegmentedControl uses WAI-ARIA radiogroup / radio with arrow keys.
